rules: A row goes to the topic of its subject, not its class. A dust-monitoring duty is Fugitive dust, not a monitoring topic.

Species-specific rows go to the species topic when one exists (Burrowing owl, Giant garter snake, Sandhill crane, Elderberry shrubs, Bumble bees and monarchs, Bats, Kit fox and badger dens, Vernal pools). Otherwise the species is a parameter on a cross-species topic.

Approval gates go to their subject topic with gate=true (barge plan to Barges, dewatering plan to Dewatering, sound abatement plan to Pile driving, exclusion plan to Burrowing owl). Only generic gates go to Agency approvals.

Specific exceedance and sighting reports go to their subject topic (hydroacoustic to Pile driving, NAL to Stormwater, air increment to Fugitive dust, BUOW sightings to Burrowing owl). Only generic ones go to the reporting topics.
